name: Claims Processing Workforce
description: A coordinated team of Digital Workers that takes an insurance claim from first notification of loss all the way through to settlement and closure, with continuous compliance oversight. Each Digital Worker orchestrates several specialist agents and hands off to the next.
outcome: First notification of loss → validated, assessed, settled and closed claim

stages.name: Intake Channels
stages.summary: Four channel-specific FNOL orchestrations, each tailored to its intake method. Every channel guides the claimant through first notification of loss and produces a normalised claim package handed off to the Claim Digital Worker.
stages.handoff: Normalised claim package → Claim Digital Worker

members.name: Web Intake
members.role: Conversational web self-service FNOL. Guides the claimant through intake, validates identity, collects evidence and normalises the result into a canonical claim package.

members.name: Mobile Intake
members.role: Mobile FNOL orchestration. Captures GPS location, photos and telematics data alongside loss details; normalises into the canonical claim package.

members.name: Call Centre
members.role: Voice FNOL orchestration. Transcribes the call, extracts structured data via NLP and provides real-time agent-assist; normalises into the canonical claim package.

members.name: Branch
members.role: In-person FNOL orchestration. Supports CSR-assisted intake, paper document scanning and in-person identity verification; normalises into the canonical claim package.

stages.name: Claim Digital Worker
stages.summary: Receives the normalised claim package from any intake channel and orchestrates the full post-intake processing pipeline — Doc Review, Fraud, Policy, Settlement — with Compliance running continuously alongside.

members.name: Claim Digital Worker
members.role: Post-intake orchestrator. Coordinates the full processing pipeline across Doc Review, Fraud, Policy, Settlement and Compliance.

members.name: System of Record
members.role: Core claims platform. The CDW creates the claim record here on receipt; every downstream digital worker reads and writes to it throughout processing.

members.name: Doc Review Digital Worker
members.role: Orchestrates document understanding and evidence collection.

members.name: Settlement Digital Worker
members.role: Orchestrates settlement calculation, payment and closure.

members.name: Compliance Agent
members.role: Cross-cutting regulatory oversight running alongside the entire pipeline.

stages.name: Doc Review Digital Worker
stages.summary: Ingests and understands submitted documents and evidence. Classifies, extracts and validates data, routing low-confidence cases to a human reviewer.

members.name: Doc Review Digital Worker
members.role: Orchestrates document understanding and evidence collection.

members.name: Data Validation
members.role: Validates extracted data against expected schema.

stages.name: Fraud Digital Worker
stages.summary: Assesses fraud risk using rules, scoring, network analysis and external data, then ranks the claim. High-risk cases escalate to a deep fraud review.

members.name: Fraud Ranking
members.role: Combines signals into a ranked fraud risk.

stages.name: Policy Digital Worker
stages.summary: Determines coverage against the policy, reasons about applicability and produces an explainable decision. Ambiguous cases escalate; claimants are kept informed.

members.name: Policy Review
members.role: Matches the claim against policy terms.

members.name: Outreach
members.role: Communicates updates and requests to the claimant.

stages.name: Settlement Digital Worker
stages.summary: Calculates the settlement, runs sanctions/AML checks, makes payment and closes the claim. Negotiation is handled by a human where required.

members.name: Payment
members.role: Executes the payment to the claimant.

members.name: Closure & Indexing
members.role: Closes and indexes the claim record.

stages.name: Compliance Agent
stages.summary: Cross-cutting oversight running alongside the whole process. Captures telemetry, detects anomalies, samples cases, builds evidence packs and feeds improvements back in. All actions are logged for audit replay.
stages.handoff: Audit evidence + improvement signals → continuous improvement

members.name: Compliance Agent
members.role: Coordinates regulatory oversight across the workforce.
